0022600190.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-6, 13th in the East) visit the Atlanta Hawks (6-4, first in the Southeast, on a three-game win streak), with the Nets going 1-3 on the road this season and Egor Demin out with a leg bruise. Atlanta will be without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Nets lost 0-4, including a 141-107 defeat in Brooklyn on April 3, 2026.
